items.title: Amazon (AMZN) Is Reworking Its Air Fleet With 30 A330 Freighters By 2027
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) plans to transition its air cargo fleet from Boeing 767 aircraft to Airbus A330 freighters. Air Transport Services Group will acquire and convert 30 Airbus A330 jets into freighters to support Amazon's air network. ATSG expects to begin operating the Airbus A330 cargo aircraft for Amazon in 2027 as part of the refreshed fleet.
